subject.title: Feature: Trigger model fallback on context length exceeded

question: Should exhausted context overflow automatically change the conversation's active model, and if so must the retry occur only before side-effecting tool work and persist as the session's auto fallback?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally keeps overflow inside compaction to avoid unsafe replay and smaller-window candidates; changing it affects user-visible model selection, tool side effects, and persisted session state.

options.title: Guarded persistent fallback
options.body: Retry only from a replay-safe boundary on a candidate with verified effective headroom, then persist it through the existing auto-fallback session contract.

options.title: Temporary overflow retry
options.body: Use a larger candidate only for the failed turn without changing the stored active model, accepting additional runtime and session-state complexity.

options.title: Keep compaction-only
options.body: Retain the current policy and improve terminal overflow messaging and recovery actions instead of automatically changing models.

recommendation.title: Guarded persistent fallback
recommendation.body: Retry only from a replay-safe boundary on a candidate with verified effective headroom, then persist it through the existing auto-fallback session contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior issue review and recent central fallback/runtime history make steipete the strongest available owner for this cross-model session contract decision.
